response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on experience across web, backend, embedded and open-source work, plus a CS degree and genuine community teaching activity. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position requiring German at C1 minimum — he lists only basic German — and his resume shows no formal people-leadership, team-management, or technical project-management responsibility. There is also little evidence of the required IT architecture, UML/modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance/risk background, and Python is absent from his stack. The technical depth is impressive but the fit against the core leadership and language requirements is weak.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ yrs) across many stacks and platforms
Strong open-source credentials: founder of GISCollective, multiple D/Linux libraries
Proven knowledge-sharing: conference talks, workshops, courses — mentoring potential
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely disqualifying
No formal leadership, line-management, or project-management track record
Little evidence of IT architecture, UML/modeling, security/compliance, or Python

key_factors.factor: Lack of team leadership / project management experience
Strong open-source, Linux, and broad senior engineering depth
